I couldn't find a name for Kwame's night-dispatch contact at Driftmoor. I checked the places you can see: #coastal-team, #coastal-random, #general, #help-it-ops, our DM and the shared Coastal files. None of them names that person.

The Coastal cheat sheet does confirm the patch. It says the tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B for Driftmoor Marine Freight, and engineering supplied a manual CSV patch for "the night dispatcher". It doesn't say who that is, and it has no email address.

Kwame is the one most likely to know, so ask him directly. If you have the contact's address, I can draft the patch note for you. Anything addressed outside pemberline.com, even as a draft, needs Ruth Calloway's approval first. I'd request that once we have the name and address.
